title: Hamiltonicity conjecture for regular sublinear expanders
statement: For $varepsilon>0$, let an $(\varepsilon,d)$-expander be the sublinear-expansion notion used in the source. **Hamiltonicity conjecture for regular sublinear expanders.** There exists $d_0$ such that, for every $d\geq d_0$, every $d$-regular $(\varepsilon,d)$-expander contains a Hamilton cycle. The parser marks this conjecture as resolved by Draganić, Montgomery, Munhá Correia, Pokrovskiy and Sudakov.
source_name: Richard Montgomery, “Recent progress in graph theory using expansion”, arXiv:2607.26049 (2026).
references:
**3 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2024–2026). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:2605.15043](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15043), [arXiv:2402.06603](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.06603).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.26049

Status: the source reports no resolution (as of July 2026); treated as **open**. (An automated reading suggested “solved”, which the source does not establish — worth checking against the literature.)
